name: Kiwi 商家工作台
description: 查看商品目录与库存、跟进 A2A 磋商记录和人工处理队列、读取经营摘要，并生成需批准后执行的商品变更草稿。
description_zh: 查看商品目录与库存、跟进 A2A 磋商记录和人工处理队列、读取经营摘要，并生成需批准后执行的商品变更草稿。
description_en: Browse catalog and inventory, follow A2A negotiation records and the human review queue, read business snapshots, and draft product changes that require approval before execution.
examples_zh: 我现在目录里有哪些商品？
最近有买家来磋商吗？进行到哪一步了？
帮我把 sku-001 的价格调成 88 元，先生成草稿等我批准
examples_en: What products are in my catalog right now?
Any buyers negotiating with me recently? What stage are they at?
Draft a price change of sku-001 to 88 CNY and wait for my approval
